item.title: visualstudio: Preparing for Your Next Certification Could Start with Your Visual Studio Subscription
item.description:
The post says Visual Studio subscription holders may already have access to resources that can help prepare for Microsoft certification, including courses, labs, and hands-on exercises. It frames the subscription as a starting point for finding study materials and planning certification prep.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
